definitions.explanation: Heavy fog that significantly reduces visibility. A meteorological term often used in weather forecasts and warnings.

examples.japanese: {濃霧|のうむ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠航|けっこう}→欠航：09509_kekkou⟧になった。
examples.english: The flight was canceled due to dense fog.

examples.japanese: {濃霧|のうむ}{注意報|ちゅういほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A dense fog advisory was issued.

examples.japanese: {濃霧|のうむ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{視界|しかい}→視界：14137_shikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's almost no visibility due to the dense fog.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧/のう (dense, thick) + ⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧ (fog)

WEATHER TERMINOLOGY:
- {濃霧|のうむ}{注意報|ちゅういほう} - dense fog advisory
- {濃霧|のうむ}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧ - dense fog warning
- {視程|してい} - visibility (technical term)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃霧|のうむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧ (dense fog forms)
- {濃霧|のうむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ (to be enveloped in dense fog)
- {濃霧|のうむ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{視界|しかい}→視界：14137_shikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (poor visibility due to fog)
- {濃霧|のうむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧ (dense fog lifts)

RELATED WEATHER WORDS:
- ⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧ - fog (general)
- ⟦{朝靄|あさもや}→朝靄：07866_asamoya⟧ - morning mist (lighter)
- もや - haze, mist
- ⟦{霞|かすみ}→霞：05042_kasumi⟧ - haze (often spring)
